articles.title: Cong Retains Raja Warring As Punjab Chief, Appoints Channi To Head Campaign Committee
articles.description: The Congress has finalised its leadership team for the upcoming Punjab Assembly elections, retaining Amarinder Raja Warring as the state unit chief while appointing former Chief Minister Charanjit Singh Channi as chairman of the campaign committee. Partap Singh Bajwa will continue as Leader of Opposition, with Vijay Inder Singla heading the election management committee and Amar Singh leading the manifesto panel. The party said maintaining organisational unity ahead of the polls was a key factor behind retaining Warring.
